:::{#def-lik}
#### Likelihood of a dataset

Let $\vx \eqdef \x1n$ be a dataset with corresponding random vector $\vX$,
and let $\p_{\Th}(\vX = \vx)$ be a probability model for the distribution of $\vX$,
with unknown parameter vector $\Th$.
The **likelihood** of the parameter value $\th$,
for model $\p_{\Th}$ and data $\vX = \vx$,
is the *joint probability* (or joint density) of $\vX = \vx$ when $\Th = \th$:

{{< include sds/_subfiles/intro-MLEs/_eq-def-lik.qmd >}}

:::
